title: EdgeHorizons x Redwood: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot adjustment request
text:
EdgeHorizons x Redwood: Marketplace co-sell demo — slot adjustment request

['From: Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@edgehorizons.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace co-sell demo — proposed slot next Tuesday

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. The EdgeHorizons product team is excited to run the joint marketplace demo for our mutual pipeline. We pulled together a short scope doc (attached) and wanted to lock a 45-minute slot next Tuesday, Sept 28, 10:00–10:45 BST — that would give us the EU audience we want.

Can you confirm Redwood availability and whether we should include an SI lead for the technical walkthrough? If so, we can loop them in and share the runbook.

Att: EdgeHorizons_Demo_Scope.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Marco Rinaldi
Partnerships
EdgeHorizons
marco.r@edgehorizons.com

---
', 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@edgehorizons.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo — proposed slot next Tuesday

Hi Marco — welcome, and thanks for the scope doc.

Quick notes: 45 minutes is perfect. I have a recurring conflict during the 10:00 BST window that day (leadership sync) but can cover the co-sell narrative and hand off to an SI for the deep demo. Kimberly, can you confirm SI availability or suggest an alternate time window?

Priyom — FYI on marketplace listing previews and to confirm whether we should route the recording to the partner listing team after the session. I also attached the first-draft runbook for your review.

Proposed alternatives if Kimberly is unavailable:
- Sept 28, 11:30–12:15 BST (slightly later EU-friendly slot)
- Sept 29, 09:00–09:45 BST (earlier morning)

If either works for you, we’ll lock and send an invite with the run-of-show.

Att: Redwood_Runbook_v1.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0192

---
', 'From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@edgehorizons.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T12:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo — proposed slot next Tuesday

Hey all — I can join as the SI lead but I have a hard stop at 11:15 BST that day. Given that, the 11:30 BST slot Vivek suggested is safer for the SI portion. If we go 11:30–12:15 BST, I’ll run the architecture + integration demo and ensure we cover failover/quantization questions.

Notes for the runbook: please add a short slide for the model-variant fallback story and a 5-minute Q&A buffer focused on observability (tracing, token-level cost). Marco, I can prep two quick screenshots from our Dedicated console.

If Marco confirms 11:30, I’ll accept the invite and add the run-of-show.

Kimberly Park
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

---
', 'From: Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@edgehorizons.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell demo — proposed slot next Tuesday

Thanks — 11:30–12:15 BST on Sept 28 works for our lead and the AE. We appreciate the SI buffers and the observability callouts. We’ll send a calendar invite from sales@edgehorizons.com; I also uploaded a short customer-facing slide deck and a recording consent form to the shared folder.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Runbook_v1.pdf (redwood), EdgeHorizons_Demo_Scope.pdf (edgehorizons)

Shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cEdgeDemoRunbook
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7345

See you then — Marco

---
']
